# HollyHock

> HollyHock is an c/c++ framework for building programs on casio classpad. 

- HollyHock uses a custom trimmed down version of the libc.
- HollyHock have both the version 2 and 3. You should use the version 3 unless asked otherwise.

## Documentation Sets

- [Abridged documentation](https://classpaddev.github.io/wiki/llms-small.txt): a compact version of the documentation for HollyHock, with non-essential content removed
- [Complete documentation](https://classpaddev.github.io/wiki/llms-full.txt): the full documentation for HollyHock
- [Reference](https://classpaddev.github.io/wiki/_llms-txt/reference.txt): terse, structured descriptions of HollyHock APIs
- [How-to Recipes](https://classpaddev.github.io/wiki/_llms-txt/how-to-recipes.txt): guided examples of adding features to an HollyHock project
- [Python Extra](https://classpaddev.github.io/wiki/_llms-txt/python-extra.txt): How to use Python on the classpad
- [Migration Guides](https://classpaddev.github.io/wiki/_llms-txt/migration-guides.txt): advice on how to migrate to V3 (hh3)

## Notes

- The complete documentation includes all content from the official documentation
- The content is automatically generated from the same source as the official documentation

## Optional

- [The Classpad.Dev blog](https://classpaddev.github.io/blog/): the latest news about Classpad and HollyHock development
